bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 資治通鑑 第191卷卷第一百九十一

translations.literal: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 191, the one hundred ninety-first scroll.
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 191.

sentences.zh: 【唐紀七】 起閼逢涒灘六月，盡柔兆閹茂八月，凡二年有奇。

translations.literal: [Tang Records 7] From the sixth month of Eyan Tuitan through the eighth month of Rouzhao Yanmao; in all a little more than two years.
translations.idiomatic: [Tang Records 7] From the sixth month of Eyan Tuitan through the eighth month of Rouzhao Yanmao—a little more than two years in all.

sentences.zh: 六月，辛丑，上幸仁智宮避暑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou, the emperor visited Renzhi Palace to escape the summer heat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinchou, the emperor went to Renzhi Palace to escape the summer heat.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，瀧州、扶州獠作亂，遣南尹州都督李光度等擊平之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Liao of Long and Fu prefectures rebelled; the court sent the Nanyinzhou area commander Li Guangdu and others to attack and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Liao people of Long and Fu prefectures rose in revolt; the court sent the Nanyinzhou area commander Li Guangdu and others to attack and put down the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，吐谷渾寇扶州，刺史蔣善合擊走之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Tuyuhun raided Fu Prefecture; the prefect Jiang Shanhe attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Tuyuhun raided Fu Prefecture; Prefect Jiang Shanhe attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，慶州都督楊文幹反。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Qingzhou area commander Yang Wengan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Qingzhou area commander Yang Wengan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 初，齊王元吉勸太子建成除秦王世民，曰：「當為兄手刃之！」

translations.literal: Earlier, Prince of Qi Yuanji urged the Crown Prince Jiancheng to eliminate the Prince of Qin Shimin, saying, "I ought to kill him for you with my own hand!"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Prince of Qi Li Yuanji had urged Crown Prince Li Jiancheng to eliminate Prince of Qin Li Shimin, saying, "Let me kill him for you with my own hand!"

sentences.zh: 世民從上幸元吉第，元吉伏護軍宇文寶於寢內，欲刺世民；

translations.literal: Shimin followed the emperor on a visit to Yuanji's residence; Yuanji stationed the guard officer Yuwen Bao in the bedchamber to stab Shimin;
translations.idiomatic: When Shimin accompanied the emperor on a visit to Yuanji's residence, Yuanji hid guard officer Yuwen Bao in the bedchamber to stab Shimin;

sentences.zh: 建成性頗仁厚，遽止之。

translations.literal: Jiancheng's nature was rather humane and generous, and he at once stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: Jiancheng, whose nature was rather humane, stopped him at once.

sentences.zh: 元吉慍曰：「為兄計耳，於我何有！」

translations.literal: Yuanji said angrily, "I am scheming for my elder brother—what is it to me!"
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji said angrily, "I am doing this for my elder brother—what do I get out of it!"

sentences.zh: 建成擅募長安及四方驍勇二千餘人為東宮衛士，分屯左、右長林，號長林兵。

translations.literal: Jiancheng on his own authority recruited more than two thousand fierce warriors from Chang'an and from all quarters as Eastern Palace guards, stationed them separately at Left and Right Changlin, and called them the Changlin troops.
translations.idiomatic: On his own authority Jiancheng recruited more than two thousand fierce warriors from Chang'an and from all quarters as Eastern Palace guards, quartered them at Left and Right Changlin, and called them the Changlin troops.

sentences.zh: 又密使右虞侯率可達志從燕王李藝發幽州突騎三百，置宮東諸坊，欲以補東宮長上，為人所告。

translations.literal: He also secretly sent the Right Yuhou commander Kedazhi to obtain three hundred frontier cavalry from Prince of Yan Li Yi in Youzhou, place them in the wards east of the palace, and use them to fill out the Eastern Palace changshang; someone reported this.
translations.idiomatic: He also secretly sent Right Yuhou commander Kedazhi to obtain three hundred frontier cavalry from Prince of Yan Li Yi in Youzhou and station them in the wards east of the palace, intending to fill out the Eastern Palace changshang ranks; someone reported the scheme.

sentences.zh: 上召建成責之，流可達志於巂州。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Jiancheng and rebuked him, and exiled Kedazhi to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Jiancheng and rebuked him, and exiled Kedazhi to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 楊文幹嘗宿衛東宮，建成與之親厚，私使募壯士送長安。

translations.literal: Yang Wengan had once served as night guard at the Eastern Palace; Jiancheng was on close terms with him and privately had him recruit stalwart men and send them to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wengan had once served as night guard at the Eastern Palace; Jiancheng was on close terms with him and privately had him recruit stalwart men and send them to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 上將幸仁智宮，命建成居守，世民、元吉皆從。

translations.literal: When the emperor was about to visit Renzhi Palace, he ordered Jiancheng to remain and hold the capital; Shimin and Yuanji both accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to visit Renzhi Palace, he ordered Jiancheng to remain in the capital as regent; Shimin and Yuanji both accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 建成使元吉就圖世民，曰：「安危之計，決在今歲！」

translations.literal: Jiancheng had Yuanji go and plot against Shimin, saying, "The plan for safety or peril is settled this year!"
translations.idiomatic: Jiancheng had Yuanji go and plot against Shimin, saying, "Whether we live or die will be decided this year!"

sentences.zh: 又使郎將爾朱煥、校尉橋公山以甲遺文幹。

translations.literal: He also sent the langjiang Erzhu Huan and the xiaowei Qiao Gongshan to present armor to Wengan.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Langjiang Erzhu Huan and Xiaowei Qiao Gongshan to deliver armor to Wengan.

sentences.zh: 二人至豳州，上變，告太子使文幹舉兵，使表裡相應；

translations.literal: When the two men reached Binzhou, they submitted a petition of accusation, reporting that the crown prince had had Wengan raise troops so that inside and outside might act in concert;
translations.idiomatic: When the two reached Bin Prefecture, they submitted a petition accusing the crown prince of ordering Wengan to raise troops so that capital and frontier might act in concert;

sentences.zh: 又有寧州人杜鳳舉亦詣宮言狀。

translations.literal: there was also a man of Ningzhou, Du Fengju, who likewise went to the palace to state the facts.
translations.idiomatic: and a man of Ning Prefecture, Du Fengju, also went to the palace to report the same.

sentences.zh: 上怒，托他事，手詔召建成，令詣行在。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry; on the pretext of another matter he issued a personal edict summoning Jiancheng and ordered him to come to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious; on the pretext of another matter he issued a personal edict summoning Jiancheng and ordering him to come to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 建成懼，不敢赴。

translations.literal: Jiancheng was afraid and did not dare go.
translations.idiomatic: Jiancheng was afraid and did not dare go.

sentences.zh: 太子舍人徐師謨勸之據城舉兵；

translations.literal: The crown prince's gentleman attendant Xu Shimou urged him to hold the city and raise troops;
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Gentleman Attendant Xu Shimou urged him to hold the city and raise troops;

sentences.zh: 詹事主簿趙弘智勸之貶損車服，屏從者，詣上謝罪，建成乃詣仁智宮。

translations.literal: the household steward's registrar Zhao Hongzhi urged him to lower his carriage and dress, dismiss his attendants, and go to the emperor to beg forgiveness; Jiancheng then went to Renzhi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Household Steward Registrar Zhao Hongzhi urged him to travel in reduced state, leave his attendants behind, and go to beg the emperor's pardon; Jiancheng then set out for Renzhi Palace.

sentences.zh: 未至六十里，悉留其官屬於毛鴻賓堡，以十餘騎往見上，叩頭謝罪，奮身自擲，幾至於絕。

translations.literal: Before he had gone sixty li, he left all his officials at Maohongbin Fort and went with a dozen or so horsemen to see the emperor; he kowtowed in apology and threw himself about in anguish, nearly to the point of death.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had gone sixty li, he left all his officials at Maohongbin Fort and rode on with only a dozen horsemen to see the emperor; he kowtowed in apology and threw himself about in anguish, nearly fainting.

sentences.zh: 上怒不解，是夜，置之幕下，飼以麥飯，使殿中監陳福防守，遣司農卿宇文穎馳召文幹。

translations.literal: The emperor's anger did not subside; that night he placed Jiancheng under a tent, fed him barley meal, and had the palace director Chen Fu guard him; he sent the minister of imperial granaries Yuwen Ying posthaste to summon Wengan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's anger did not subside; that night he lodged Jiancheng under a tent, fed him barley meal, and had Palace Director Chen Fu guard him; he sent Minister of Imperial Granaries Yuwen Ying posthaste to summon Wengan.

sentences.zh: 穎至慶州，以情告之，文幹遂舉兵反。

translations.literal: When Ying reached Qingzhou, he told Wengan how things stood, and Wengan thereupon raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying reached Qing Prefecture, he told Wengan how things stood, and Wengan thereupon raised troops in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 上遣左武衛將軍錢九隴與靈州都督楊師道擊之。

translations.literal: The emperor sent the Left Wuwei general Qian Jiulong and the Lingzhou area commander Yang Shidao to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Left Wuwei General Qian Jiulong and Lingzhou area commander Yang Shidao to attack him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上召秦王世民謀之，世民曰：「文幹豎子，敢為狂逆，計府僚已應擒戮；

translations.literal: On jiazi, the emperor summoned the Prince of Qin Shimin to deliberate; Shimin said, "Wengan is a mere stripling who dared commit wild treason; I reckon his staff have already been seized and executed;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor summoned Prince of Qin Li Shimin to counsel with him. Shimin said, "Wengan is a mere stripling who dared commit wild treason; his staff have surely already been seized and executed;

sentences.zh: 若不爾，正應遣一將討之耳。」

translations.literal: if not, one need only send a general to suppress him."
translations.idiomatic: if not, we need only send a general to suppress him."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「不然。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Not so.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Not so.

sentences.zh: 文幹事連建成，恐應之者眾。

translations.literal: Wengan's affair is linked with Jiancheng; I fear many will respond.
translations.idiomatic: Wengan's affair is tied to Jiancheng; I fear many will rally to him.

sentences.zh: 汝宜自行，還，立汝為太子。

translations.literal: You ought to go in person; when you return, I will install you as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: You should go in person; when you return, I will make you crown prince.

sentences.zh: 吾不能效隋文帝自誅其子，當封建成為蜀王。

translations.literal: I cannot imitate Emperor Wen of Sui in executing my own son; I shall enfeoff Jiancheng as King of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: I cannot imitate Emperor Wen of Sui in executing my own son; I shall enfeoff Jiancheng as King of Shu.

sentences.zh: 蜀兵脆弱，它日苟能事汝，汝宜全之；

translations.literal: Shu's troops are weak; if someday he can serve you, you ought to spare him;
translations.idiomatic: Shu's troops are weak; if someday he can serve you, you ought to spare him;

sentences.zh: 不能事汝，汝取之易耳！」

translations.literal: if he cannot serve you, you will take him easily!"
translations.idiomatic: if he cannot serve you, you will take him easily enough!"

sentences.zh: 上以仁智宮在山中，恐盜兵猝發，夜，帥宿衛南出山外，行數十里，東宮官屬將卒繼至者，皆令三十人為隊，分兵圍守之。

translations.literal: Because Renzhi Palace was in the mountains, the emperor feared that bandit troops might burst forth suddenly; at night he led the palace guard south out beyond the mountains, marched several tens of li, and for Eastern Palace officials and soldiers who arrived afterward, he had them formed into companies of thirty men each and stationed troops around them in separate detachments.
translations.idiomatic: Because Renzhi Palace stood in the mountains, the emperor feared that rebel troops might strike suddenly; at night he led the palace guard south out of the mountains and marched several tens of li. Eastern Palace officials and soldiers who arrived afterward were formed into companies of thirty and surrounded by detachments on guard.

sentences.zh: 明日，復還仁智宮。

translations.literal: The next day he returned again to Renzhi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he returned to Renzhi Palace.

sentences.zh: 世民既行，元吉與妃嬪更迭為建成請，封德彝復為之營解於外，上意遂變，復遣建成還京師居守。

translations.literal: After Shimin had set out, Yuanji and the consorts took turns pleading for Jiancheng; Feng Deyi again worked to clear matters for him from outside, and the emperor's mind thereupon changed; he again sent Jiancheng back to the capital to remain and hold it.
translations.idiomatic: After Shimin had set out, Yuanji and the consorts took turns pleading for Jiancheng; Feng Deyi again worked to clear matters for him from outside, and the emperor's mind changed; he sent Jiancheng back to the capital to remain as regent.

sentences.zh: 惟責以兄弟不睦，歸罪於太子中允王珪、左衛率韋挺、天策兵曹參軍杜淹，並流於巂州。

translations.literal: He only blamed them for discord among the brothers, laid the guilt on the crown prince's zhongyun Wang Gui, the Left Weilü Wei Ting, and the Heavenly Stratagem army caocan Du Yan, and exiled them all to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He blamed only the brothers' discord, laid the guilt on Crown Prince Zhongyun Wang Gui, Left Weilü Wei Ting, and Heavenly Stratagem Army Caocan Du Yan, and exiled them all to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 挺，沖之子也。

translations.literal: Ting was the son of Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Ting was the son of Wei Chong.

sentences.zh: 初，洛陽既平，杜淹久不得調，欲求事建成。

translations.literal: Earlier, after Luoyang had been pacified, Du Yan long went without an appointment and wished to attach himself to Jiancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after Luoyang had been pacified, Du Yan had long gone without an appointment and wished to attach himself to Jiancheng.

sentences.zh: 房玄齡以淹多狡數，恐其教導建成，益為世民不利，乃言於世民，引入天策府。

translations.literal: Fang Xuanling, because Yan was full of crafty schemes, feared that he would instruct Jiancheng to Shimin's further disadvantage, and therefore spoke to Shimin and had him brought into the Heavenly Stratagem headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xuanling, knowing Yan's crafty ways, feared he would counsel Jiancheng to Shimin's further disadvantage and spoke to Shimin, who brought Yan into the Heavenly Stratagem headquarters.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇代州之武周城，州兵擊破之。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Wuzhou city in Daizhou; the prefectural troops attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided Wuzhou city in Dai Prefecture; the prefectural troops attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，己巳，苑君璋以突厥寇朔州，總管秦武通擊卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jisi, Yuan Junzhang with the Turks raided Shuozhou; the area commander Qin Wutong attacked and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jisi, Yuan Junzhang led Turks in a raid on Shuo Prefecture; area commander Qin Wutong attacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 楊文幹襲陷寧州，驅掠吏民出據百家堡。

translations.literal: Yang Wengan made a surprise attack and seized Ningzhou, drove off officials and people, and went out to hold Baijia Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wengan made a surprise attack and seized Ning Prefecture, drove off officials and commoners, and withdrew to hold Baijia Fort.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民軍至寧州，其黨皆潰。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Qin Shimin's army reached Ningzhou, his partisans all scattered.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Qin Li Shimin's army reached Ning Prefecture, Wengan's followers all scattered.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，文幹為其麾下所殺，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Wengan was killed by his own subordinates, and his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wengan was killed by his own subordinates, and his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 獲宇文穎，誅之。

translations.literal: Yuwen Ying was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Ying was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，梁師都行台白伏願來降。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Liang Shidu's headquarters officer Bai Fuyuan came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Liang Shidu's headquarters officer Bai Fuyuan came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，突厥寇原州；

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Turks raided Yuanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Turks raided Yuan Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 遣寧州刺史鹿大師救之，又遣楊師道趨大木根山，邀其歸路。

translations.literal: the court sent the Ningzhou prefect Lu Dashi to rescue it, and also sent Yang Shidao to hurry to Damugen Mountain to intercept their line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: the court sent Ning Prefecture prefect Lu Dashi to the rescue and also sent Yang Shidao to hurry to Damugen Mountain to cut off their retreat.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，突厥寇隴州；

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Turks raided Longzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Turks raided Long Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 遣護軍尉遲敬德擊之。

translations.literal: the court sent the guard general Yuchi Jingde to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: the court sent Guard General Yuchi Jingde to attack them.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾寇岷州。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun raided Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun raided Min Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，吐谷渾、党項寇松州。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Tuyuhun and the Tangut raided Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Tuyuhun and the Tangut raided Song Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，突厥寇陰盤。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Turks raided Yinpan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Turks raided Yinpan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，扶州刺史蔣善合擊吐谷渾於松州赤磨鎮，破之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Fu Prefecture prefect Jiang Shanhe attacked Tuyuhun at Chimo town in Songzhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Fu Prefecture prefect Jiang Shanhe attacked Tuyuhun at Chimo in Song Prefecture and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，突厥吐利設與苑君璋寇并州。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Turk Tuli she and Yuan Junzhang raided Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Turk Tuli she and Yuan Junzhang raided Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，車駕還京師。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 或說上曰：「突厥所以屢寇關中者，以子女玉帛皆在長安故也。

translations.literal: Someone said to the emperor, "The reason the Turks repeatedly raid Guanzhong is that their sons and daughters, jade, and silks are all in Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Someone said to the emperor, "The Turks raid Guanzhong again and again because their families and all their wealth are in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 若焚長安而不都，則胡寇自息矣。」

translations.literal: If we burn Chang'an and do not make it the capital, then the barbarian raids will cease of themselves."
translations.idiomatic: Burn Chang'an and move the capital elsewhere, and the barbarian raids will cease of themselves."

sentences.zh: 上以為然，遣中書侍郎宇文士及逾南山至樊、鄧，行可居之地，將徒都之。

translations.literal: The emperor thought this correct; he sent the Secretariat vice-director Yuwen Shiji over the Southern Mountains to Fan and Deng to survey habitable ground, intending to move the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thought this correct and sent Secretariat Vice-Director Yuwen Shiji over the Southern Mountains to Fan and Deng to survey habitable ground, intending to move the capital.

sentences.zh: 太子建成、齊王元吉、裴寂皆贊成其策，蕭瑀等雖知其不可，而不敢諫。

translations.literal: The crown prince Jiancheng, the Prince of Qi Yuanji, and Pei Ji all approved the plan; Xiao Yu and others, though they knew it could not be done, did not dare remonstrate.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Jiancheng, Prince of Qi Yuanji, and Pei Ji all approved the plan; Xiao Yu and others, though they knew it was wrong, did not dare remonstrate.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民諫曰：「戎狄為患，自古有之。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin Shimin remonstrated, saying, "Barbarian troubles have existed since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qin Shimin remonstrated, saying, "Barbarian troubles have existed since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 陛下以聖武龍興，光宅中夏，精兵百萬，所征無敵，奈何以胡寇擾邊，遽遷都以避之，貽四海之羞，為百世之笑乎！

translations.literal: Your Majesty rose by sacred martial prowess and made the central land your dwelling; you have a million crack troops, and none can stand against your expeditions—how can you, because barbarian raiders trouble the border, hastily move the capital to avoid them, and leave shame to the four seas and laughter to a hundred generations!
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty rose by sacred martial prowess and made the central land your dwelling; you have a million crack troops whom none can withstand—how can you, because barbarian raiders trouble the border, hastily move the capital to avoid them, and bring shame on the empire and laughter for a hundred generations!

sentences.zh: 彼霍去病漢廷一將，猶志滅匈奴；

translations.literal: That Huo Qubing was but one general of the Han court, yet still aspired to destroy the Xiongnu;
translations.idiomatic: Huo Qubing was but one general of the Han court, yet still aspired to destroy the Xiongnu;

sentences.zh: 況臣忝備籓維，願假數年之期，請系頡利之頸，致之闕下。

translations.literal: how much more, when your servant unworthily holds a frontier post, would I beg a few years' time and ask to bind Jieli's neck and deliver him below the palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: how much more, when I unworthily hold a frontier post, may I beg a few years' time and bind Jieli's neck and deliver him to your palace gates.

sentences.zh: 若其不效，遷都未晚。」

translations.literal: If that fails, moving the capital will not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: If I fail, moving the capital will not be too late."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「善。」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Well said."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Well said."

sentences.zh: 建成曰：「昔樊噲欲以十萬眾橫行匈奴中，秦王之言得無似之！」

translations.literal: Jiancheng said, "In the past Fan Kuai wished to lead a hundred thousand men rampaging through the Xiongnu lands—does not the Prince of Qin's speech resemble that!"
translations.idiomatic: Jiancheng said, "Fan Kuai once wanted to lead a hundred thousand men rampaging through the Xiongnu lands—does not the Prince of Qin's speech sound just like that!"

sentences.zh: 世民曰：「形勢各異，用兵不同，樊噲小豎，何足道乎！

translations.literal: Shimin said, "Circumstances differ, and the use of troops differs; Fan Kuai was a petty fellow—what is there to mention!
translations.idiomatic: Shimin said, "Circumstances differ and the use of troops differs; Fan Kuai was a petty fellow—not worth mentioning!

sentences.zh: 不出十年，必定漠北，非敢虛言也！」

translations.literal: Within ten years I shall surely pacify the northern desert—it is no empty boast!"
translations.idiomatic: Within ten years I shall surely pacify the northern desert—that is no empty boast!"

sentences.zh: 上乃止。

translations.literal: The emperor then stopped the plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 建成與妃嬪因共譖世民曰：「突厥雖屢為邊患，得賂則退。

translations.literal: Jiancheng and the consorts thereupon together slandered Shimin, saying, "Although the Turks have repeatedly been a border trouble, when bribed they withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Jiancheng and the consorts thereupon slandered Shimin together, saying, "Although the Turks have repeatedly troubled the border, they withdraw when bribed.

sentences.zh: 秦王外托禦寇之名，內欲總兵權，成其篡奪之謀耳！」

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin outwardly uses the name of repelling invaders but inwardly wishes to gather military authority and accomplish his plot to seize the throne!"
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin outwardly uses the name of repelling invaders but inwardly wishes to gather military authority and accomplish his plot to seize the throne!"

sentences.zh: 上校獵城南，太子、秦、齊王皆從，上命三子馳射角勝。

translations.literal: The emperor hunted south of the city; the crown prince and the Princes of Qin and Qi all followed; the emperor ordered the three sons to gallop and shoot in contest for victory.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hunted south of the city; the crown prince and the Princes of Qin and Qi all followed, and the emperor ordered the three sons to gallop and shoot in contest for victory.

sentences.zh: 建成有胡馬，肥壯而喜蹶，以授世民曰：「此馬甚駿，能超數丈澗。

translations.literal: Jiancheng had a barbarian horse, fat, strong, and prone to kicking up; he gave it to Shimin, saying, "This horse is very swift and can leap ravines several zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: Jiancheng had a barbarian horse, fat, strong, and prone to bucking; he gave it to Shimin, saying, "This horse is very swift and can leap ravines several zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 弟善騎，試乘之。」

translations.literal: Younger brother, you ride well—try riding it."
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother, you ride well—try it."

sentences.zh: 世民乘以逐鹿，馬蹶，世民躍立於數步之外，馬起，復乘之，如是者三，顧謂宇文士及曰：「彼欲以此見殺，死生有命，庸何傷乎！」

translations.literal: Shimin mounted it to chase deer; the horse kicked up; Shimin leaped and stood several paces away; the horse rose and he mounted again—thus three times; he turned and said to Yuwen Shiji, "They wished to kill me with this—life and death are fated; what harm is there!"
translations.idiomatic: Shimin mounted it to chase deer; the horse bucked; Shimin leaped clear several paces away; the horse rose and he mounted again—three times in all. He turned and said to Yuwen Shiji, "They meant to kill me with this—life and death are fated; what harm is there!"

sentences.zh: 建成聞之，因令妃嬪譖之於上曰：「秦王自言，我有天命，方為天下主，豈有浪死！」

translations.literal: When Jiancheng heard of it, he had the consorts slander him to the emperor, saying, "The Prince of Qin said himself, 'I have the mandate of Heaven and am destined to be lord of all under Heaven—how could I die in vain!'"
translations.idiomatic: When Jiancheng heard of it, he had the consorts slander Shimin to the emperor, saying, "The Prince of Qin said himself, 'I have the mandate of Heaven and am destined to rule the realm—how could I die in vain!'"

sentences.zh: 上大怒，先召建成、元吉，然後召世民入，責之曰：「天子自有天命，非智力可求；

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angered; he first summoned Jiancheng and Yuanji, then summoned Shimin in and rebuked him, saying, "The Son of Heaven has his own Heaven's mandate—it cannot be sought by wit or force;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious; he first summoned Jiancheng and Yuanji, then summoned Shimin and rebuked him, saying, "The Son of Heaven has his own Heaven's mandate—it cannot be sought by wit or force;

sentences.zh: 汝求之一何急邪！」

translations.literal: why are you in such haste to seek it!"
translations.idiomatic: why are you in such haste to seek it!"

sentences.zh: 世民免冠頓首，請下法司案驗。

translations.literal: Shimin removed his cap and kowtowed, asking that the matter be referred to the judicial offices for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin removed his cap and kowtowed, asking that the matter be referred to the judicial offices for investigation.

sentences.zh: 上怒不解，會有司奏突厥入寇，上乃改容，勞勉世民，命之冠帶，與謀突厥。

translations.literal: The emperor's anger did not subside; just then the offices reported a Turk invasion, and the emperor thereupon changed his expression, comforted and encouraged Shimin, ordered him to put on cap and belt, and deliberated with him on the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's anger did not subside; just then the offices reported a Turk invasion, and the emperor's expression changed; he comforted Shimin, ordered him to put on cap and belt, and deliberated with him on the Turks.

sentences.zh: 閏月，己未，詔世民、元吉將兵出幽州以御突厥，上餞之於蘭池。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiwei, an edict ordered Shimin and Yuanji to lead troops out from Youzhou to repel the Turks; the emperor saw them off at Lan Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiwei, an edict ordered Shimin and Yuanji to lead troops out from Youzhou to repel the Turks; the emperor saw them off at Lan Pool.

sentences.zh: 上每有寇盜，輒命世民討之，事平之後，猜嫌益甚。

translations.literal: Whenever there were bandits or raiders, the emperor would always order Shimin to suppress them; after matters were settled, suspicion and estrangement grew ever worse.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever there were bandits or raiders, the emperor would always order Shimin to suppress them; after each campaign suspicion and estrangement grew worse.

sentences.zh: 初，隋末，京兆韋仁壽為蜀郡司法書佐，所論囚至市，猶西向為仁壽禮佛，然後死。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the end of Sui, Wei Renshou of Jingzhao was a judicial clerk in Shu commandery; condemned prisoners, when they reached the market, still faced west to bow to the Buddha on Renshou's behalf and only then died.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the end of Sui, Wei Renshou of Jingzhao was a judicial clerk in Shu commandery; condemned prisoners, when they reached the market, still faced west to bow to the Buddha on Renshou's behalf before they died.

sentences.zh: 唐興，爨弘達帥西南夷內附，朝廷遣使撫之，類皆貪縱，遠民患之，有叛者。

translations.literal: When Tang arose, Cuan Hongda led the southwestern barbarians in submission; the court sent envoys to pacify them, who were mostly greedy and unrestrained; the distant peoples suffered from this and some rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang arose, Cuan Hongda led the southwestern tribes in submission; the court sent envoys to pacify them, who were mostly greedy and unrestrained; the distant peoples suffered and some rebelled.

sentences.zh: 仁壽時為巂州都督長史，上聞其名，命檢校南寧州都督，寄治越巂，使之歲一至其地慰撫之。

translations.literal: Renshou was then chief clerk to the Xizhou area commander; the emperor heard his name and appointed him acting Nanningzhou area commander, with administration lodged at Yuexi, ordering him to come once a year to that region to comfort and pacify the people.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou was then chief clerk to the Xizhou area commander; the emperor heard his name and appointed him acting Nanning area commander, with administration lodged at Yuexi, ordering him to visit the region once a year to comfort and pacify the people.

sentences.zh: 仁壽性寬厚，有識度，既受命，將兵五百人至西洱河，周歷數千里，蠻、夷豪帥皆望風歸附，來見仁壽。

translations.literal: Renshou's nature was generous and he had judgment; once he received the commission, he led five hundred troops to the West Er River, toured several thousand li, and the barbarian and tribal chieftains all submitted at the report of his coming and came to see Renshou.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou was generous by nature and had sound judgment; once commissioned, he led five hundred troops to the West Er River, toured several thousand li, and barbarian and tribal chieftains submitted at the report of his coming and came to see him.

sentences.zh: 仁壽承製置七州、十五縣，各以其豪帥為刺史、縣令，法令清肅，蠻、夷悅服。

translations.literal: Renshou received imperial authorization to establish seven prefectures and fifteen counties, appointing each tribal chieftain as prefect or magistrate; laws and orders were clear and strict, and the barbarians and tribes were pleased and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou received imperial authorization to establish seven prefectures and fifteen counties, appointing each tribal chieftain as prefect or magistrate; laws and orders were clear and strict, and the tribes were pleased and submitted.

sentences.zh: 將還，豪帥皆曰：「天子遣公都督南寧，何為遽去？」

translations.literal: When he was about to return, the chieftains all said, "The Son of Heaven sent you, sir, to command Nanning—why leave so soon?"
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to return, the chieftains all said, "The Son of Heaven sent you, sir, to command Nanning—why leave so soon?"

sentences.zh: 仁壽以城池未立為辭。

translations.literal: Renshou pleaded that the city walls had not yet been built.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou pleaded that the city walls had not yet been built.

sentences.zh: 蠻、夷即相帥為仁壽築城，立廨捨，旬日而就。

translations.literal: The barbarians and tribes thereupon led one another in building a city for Renshou and erecting government offices; in ten days it was done.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes thereupon joined in building a city for Renshou and erecting government offices; in ten days it was done.

sentences.zh: 仁壽乃曰：「吾受詔但令巡撫，不敢擅留。」

translations.literal: Renshou then said, "I received the edict only to tour and pacify—I dare not stay on my own authority."
translations.idiomatic: Renshou then said, "I received the edict only to tour and pacify—I dare not stay on my own authority."

sentences.zh: 蠻、夷號泣送之，因各遣子弟入貢。

translations.literal: The barbarians and tribes wept aloud as they saw him off, and each sent sons to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes wept aloud as they saw him off, and each sent sons to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，仁壽還朝，上大悅，命仁壽徙鎮南寧，以兵戍之。

translations.literal: On renxu, Renshou returned to court; the emperor was greatly pleased and ordered Renshou to transfer his command to Nanning and garrison it with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Renshou returned to court; the emperor was greatly pleased and ordered Renshou to transfer his command to Nanning and garrison it with troops.

sentences.zh: 苑君璋引突厥寇朔州。

translations.literal: Yuan Junzhang led the Turks in raiding Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Junzhang led the Turks in a raid on Shuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月，戊辰，突厥寇原州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuchen, the Turks raided Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen, the Turks raided Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，吐谷渾寇鄯州。

translations.literal: On jisi, Tuyuhun raided Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Tuyuhun raided Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，突厥寇忻州，丙子，寇并州；

translations.literal: On renshen, the Turks raided Xinzhou; on bingzi, they raided Bingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Turks raided Xin Prefecture; on bingzi, they raided Bing Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，寇綏州，刺史劉大俱擊卻之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, they raided Suizhou; the prefect Liu Daju attacked and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, they raided Sui Prefecture; Prefect Liu Daju attacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 是時，頡利、突利二可汗舉國入寇，連營南上，秦王世民引兵拒之。

translations.literal: At this time the two khans Jieli and Tuli led their whole nation in invasion, encamped in succession marching south; the Prince of Qin Shimin led troops to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Khans Jieli and Tuli led their whole nation in invasion, encamping in succession as they marched south; Prince of Qin Li Shimin led troops to resist them.

sentences.zh: 會關中久雨，糧運阻絕，士卒疲於征役，器械頓弊，朝廷及軍中鹹以為憂。

translations.literal: It happened that Guanzhong had long rains; grain transport was cut off; soldiers were worn out by campaigns; weapons were suddenly ruined; at court and in the army all alike were anxious.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong had suffered long rains; grain transport was cut off; soldiers were worn out by campaigns and weapons were ruined; at court and in the army all were anxious.

sentences.zh: 世民與虜遇於幽州，勒兵將戰。

translations.literal: Shimin encountered the barbarians at Youzhou, arrayed his troops, and was about to give battle.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin encountered the barbarians at You Prefecture, arrayed his troops, and was about to give battle.

sentences.zh: 己卯，可汗帥萬餘騎奄至城西，陳於五隴阪，將士震恐。

translations.literal: On jimao, the khan led more than ten thousand horsemen in a sudden arrival west of the city and formed battle lines at Wulong Slope; officers and soldiers were shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the khan led more than ten thousand horsemen in a sudden arrival west of the city and formed battle lines at Wulong Slope; officers and soldiers were shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 世民謂元吉曰：「今虜騎憑陵，不可示之以怯，當與之一戰，汝能與我俱乎？」

translations.literal: Shimin said to Yuanji, "Now the barbarian horsemen press upon us—we must not show them timidity; we ought to give them battle. Can you go with me?"
translations.idiomatic: Shimin said to Yuanji, "The barbarian horsemen press upon us—we must not show timidity; we ought to give them battle. Will you go with me?"

sentences.zh: 元吉懼曰：「虜形勢如此，奈何輕出？

translations.literal: Yuanji said in fear, "The barbarians' situation is like this—how can you go out lightly?
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji said in fear, "The barbarians' position is so strong—how can you go out lightly?

sentences.zh: 萬一失利，悔可及乎！」

translations.literal: If by chance we are defeated, will regret be possible!"
translations.idiomatic: If we are defeated, will regret avail us!"

sentences.zh: 世民曰：「汝不敢出，吾當獨往。

translations.literal: Shimin said, "If you do not dare go out, I shall go alone.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin said, "If you do not dare go out, I shall go alone.

sentences.zh: 汝留此觀之。」

translations.literal: You remain here and watch."
translations.idiomatic: You stay here and watch."

sentences.zh: 世民乃帥騎馳詣虜陳，告之曰：「國家與可汗和親，何為負約，深入我地！

translations.literal: Shimin then led horsemen at a gallop to the barbarian lines and told them, "Our state and the khan are joined by marriage alliance—why break the treaty and penetrate deep into our territory!
translations.idiomatic: Shimin then galloped with his horsemen to the barbarian lines and said, "Our state and the khan are joined by marriage alliance—why break the treaty and penetrate deep into our territory!

sentences.zh: 我秦王也，可汗能鬥，獨出與我斗；

translations.literal: I am the Prince of Qin; if the khan can fight, come out alone and fight me;
translations.idiomatic: I am the Prince of Qin; if the khan can fight, come out alone and fight me;

sentences.zh: 若以眾來，我直以此百騎相當耳！」

translations.literal: if you come with a multitude, I will meet you with just these hundred horsemen!"
translations.idiomatic: if you come with a multitude, I will meet you with just these hundred horsemen!"

sentences.zh: 頡利不之測，笑而不應。

translations.literal: Jieli could not fathom him; he smiled and did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Jieli could not fathom him; he smiled and did not reply.

sentences.zh: 世民又前，遣騎告突利曰：「爾往與我盟，有急相救；

translations.literal: Shimin advanced again and sent a horseman to tell Tuli, "You once allied with me and would aid me in emergency;
translations.idiomatic: Shimin advanced again and sent a horseman to tell Tuli, "You once allied with me and promised aid in emergency;

sentences.zh: 今乃引兵相攻，何無香火之情也！」

translations.literal: now you lead troops to attack me—where is the bond of sworn brotherhood!"
translations.idiomatic: now you lead troops against me—where is the bond of sworn brotherhood!"

sentences.zh: 突利亦不應。

translations.literal: Tuli also did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Tuli also did not reply.

sentences.zh: 世民又前，將渡溝水，頡利見世民輕出，又聞香火之言，疑突利與世民有謀，乃遣止世民曰：「王不須渡，我無他意，更欲與王申固盟約耳。」

translations.literal: Shimin advanced again and was about to cross the ditch; Jieli saw Shimin come out lightly and, hearing the talk of sworn brotherhood, suspected Tuli and Shimin of plotting together; he then sent word to stop Shimin, saying, "Prince, you need not cross; I have no other intent—I only wish to renew and strengthen the alliance with you."
translations.idiomatic: Shimin advanced again and was about to cross the ditch; Jieli saw Shimin come out so boldly and, hearing the talk of sworn brotherhood, suspected Tuli and Shimin of plotting together; he sent word to stop Shimin, saying, "Prince, you need not cross; I have no other intent—I only wish to renew and strengthen our alliance."

sentences.zh: 乃引兵稍卻。

translations.literal: He then drew his troops back somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: He then drew his troops back somewhat.

sentences.zh: 是後霖雨益甚，世民謂諸將曰：「虜所恃者弓矢耳，今積雨彌時，筋膠俱解，弓不可用，彼如飛鳥之折翼；

translations.literal: After this the steady rain grew heavier; Shimin said to the generals, "The barbarians rely on bow and arrow; now the rain has lasted so long that sinew and glue are all undone and bows cannot be used—they are like birds with broken wings;
translations.idiomatic: After this the steady rain grew heavier; Shimin said to the generals, "The barbarians rely on bow and arrow; the rain has lasted so long that sinew and glue are undone and bows cannot be used—they are like birds with broken wings;

sentences.zh: 吾屋居火食，刀槊犀利，以逸制勞，此而不乘，將復何待！」

translations.literal: we dwell in houses, eat cooked food, and our blades and spears are sharp—we use rest to overcome fatigue; if we do not seize this, what shall we wait for!"
translations.idiomatic: we dwell in houses, eat cooked food, and our blades and spears are sharp—we use rest to overcome their fatigue; if we do not seize this moment, what shall we wait for!"

sentences.zh: 乃潛師夜出，冒雨而進，突厥大驚。

translations.literal: He then sent troops out secretly by night, advanced through the rain, and the Turks were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent troops out secretly by night, advanced through the rain, and the Turks were greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 世民又遣說突利以利害，突利悅，聽命。

translations.literal: Shimin also sent envoys to persuade Tuli with considerations of advantage and harm; Tuli was pleased and obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin also sent envoys to persuade Tuli with considerations of advantage and harm; Tuli was pleased and obeyed.

sentences.zh: 頡利慾戰，突利不可，乃遣突利與其夾畢特勒阿史那思摩來見世民，請和親，世民許之。

translations.literal: Jieli wished to fight but Tuli would not allow it; he then sent Tuli with his jabimilitele Ashina Simo to see Shimin and request a marriage alliance; Shimin agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Jieli wished to fight but Tuli would not allow it; he then sent Tuli with his jabimilitele Ashina Simo to see Shimin and request a marriage alliance; Shimin agreed.

sentences.zh: 思摩，頡利之從叔也。

translations.literal: Simo was Jieli's younger cousin on the father's side.
translations.idiomatic: Simo was Jieli's younger cousin on the father's side.

sentences.zh: 突利因自托於世民，請結為兄弟。

translations.literal: Tuli thereupon entrusted himself to Shimin and asked to be joined as sworn brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Tuli thereupon entrusted himself to Shimin and asked to be joined as sworn brothers.

sentences.zh: 世民亦以恩意撫之，與盟而去。

translations.literal: Shimin also treated him with gracious favor, made alliance with him, and they departed.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin also treated him with gracious favor, made alliance with him, and they departed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，岐州刺史柴紹破突厥於杜陽谷。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Qi Prefecture prefect Chai Shao defeated the Turks at Duyang Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Qi Prefecture prefect Chai Shao defeated the Turks at Duyang Valley.

sentences.zh: 壬申，突厥阿史那思摩入見，上引升御榻，慰勞之。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Turk Ashina Simo came to audience; the emperor had him brought up to the imperial couch and comforted and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Turk Ashina Simo came to audience; the emperor had him brought up to the imperial couch and comforted and encouraged him.

sentences.zh: 思摩貌類胡，不類突厥，故處羅疑其非阿史那種，歷處羅、頡利世，常為夾畢特勒，終不得典兵為設。

translations.literal: Simo's appearance resembled that of the Hu and not the Turks; therefore Chuluo suspected he was not of the Ashina clan; through the reigns of Chuluo and Jieli he was always a jabimilitele and in the end never obtained command of troops as a she.
translations.idiomatic: Simo's appearance resembled that of the Hu rather than the Turks; therefore Chuluo suspected he was not of the Ashina clan; through the reigns of Chuluo and Jieli he was always a jabimilitele and never obtained command of troops as a she.

sentences.zh: 既入朝，賜爵和順王。

translations.literal: Once he entered the court, he was granted the title King of Heshun.
translations.idiomatic: Once he entered court, he was granted the title King of Heshun.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣左僕射裴寂使於突厥。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Left Pushe Pei Ji was sent as envoy to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Left Pushe Pei Ji was sent as envoy to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 九月，癸卯，日南人姜子路反，交州都督王志遠擊破之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guimao, a man of Rinan, Jiang Zilu, rebelled; the Jiaozhou area commander Wang Zhiyuan attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, a man of Rinan, Jiang Zilu, rebelled; Jiaozhou area commander Wang Zhiyuan attacked and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，突厥寇綏州，都督劉大俱擊破之，獲特勒三人。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Turks raided Suizhou; the area commander Liu Daju attacked and defeated them and captured three tele.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Turks raided Sui Prefecture; area commander Liu Daju attacked and defeated them and captured three tele.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，己巳，突厥寇甘州。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jisi, the Turks raided Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jisi, the Turks raided Gan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上校獵於鄠之南山；

translations.literal: On xinwei, the emperor conducted a hunting review south of the mountains at Hu;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the emperor conducted a hunting review south of the mountains at Hu;

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸終南。

translations.literal: on guiyou, he visited Zhongnan.
translations.idiomatic: on guiyou, he visited Zhongnan.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾及羌人寇疊州，陷合川。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun and the Qiang raided Diezhou and seized Hechuan.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun and the Qiang raided Die Prefecture and seized Hechuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上幸樓觀，謁老子祠；

translations.literal: On bingzi, the emperor visited Louguan and paid homage at the shrine of Laozi;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the emperor visited Louguan and paid homage at the shrine of Laozi;

sentences.zh: 癸未，以太牢祭隋文帝陵。

translations.literal: on guiwei, he sacrificed with the great offering at the tomb of Emperor Wen of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: on guiwei, he sacrificed with the great offering at the tomb of Emperor Wen of Sui.

sentences.zh: 十一月，丁卯，上幸龍躍宮；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, the emperor visited Longyue Palace;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, the emperor visited Longyue Palace;

sentences.zh: 庚午，還宮。

translations.literal: on gengwu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: on gengwu, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 太子詹事裴矩權檢校侍中。

translations.literal: The crown prince's household steward Pei Ju was appointed acting provisional Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Household Steward Pei Ju was appointed acting provisional Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丙辰，以壽州都督張鎮周為舒州都督。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on bingchen, the Shouzhou area commander Zhang Zhenzhou was made area commander of Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on bingchen, Shou Prefecture area commander Zhang Zhenzhou was made area commander of Shu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鎮周以舒州本其鄉里，到州，就故宅多市酒餚，召親戚故人，與之酣宴，散發箕距，如為布衣時，凡十日。

translations.literal: Zhenzhou, because Shuzhou was his native place, on reaching the prefecture went to his old residence, bought much wine and food, summoned kinsmen and old friends, and feasted with them in revelry, hair loose and legs sprawled, as when he had been a commoner—for ten days in all.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shu Prefecture was his native place, Zhenzhou on reaching office went to his old residence, bought much wine and food, summoned kinsmen and old friends, and feasted with them in revelry, hair loose and legs sprawled, as in his days as a commoner—for ten days in all.

sentences.zh: 既而分贈金帛，泣與之別，曰：「今日張鎮周猶得與故人歡飲，明日之後，則舒州都督治百姓耳，君民禮隔，不復得為交遊。」

translations.literal: Then he distributed gold and silk as gifts, wept as he parted from them, and said, "Today Zhang Zhenzhou can still drink in joy with old friends; from tomorrow on I am only the Shuzhou area commander governing the people—the rites between ruler and subject divide us, and we can no longer be companions in pleasure."
translations.idiomatic: Then he distributed gold and silk as gifts, wept as he parted from them, and said, "Today Zhang Zhenzhou can still drink in joy with old friends; from tomorrow on I am only the Shu Prefecture area commander governing the people—the rites between ruler and subject divide us, and we can no longer be companions in pleasure."

sentences.zh: 自是親戚故人犯法，一無所縱，境內肅然。

translations.literal: From then on, when kinsmen and old friends violated the law, he showed no leniency whatever, and within his jurisdiction all was orderly.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, when kinsmen and old friends violated the law, he showed no leniency whatever, and within his jurisdiction all was orderly.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣右武衛將軍段德操徇夏州地。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Right Wuwei general Duan Decao conducted a punitive sweep of Xiazhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Right Wuwei General Duan Decao conducted a punitive sweep of Xia Prefecture territory.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾寇疊州。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun raided Diezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun raided Die Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，突厥、吐谷渾各請互市，詔皆許之。

translations.literal: That month, the Turks and Tuyuhun each requested border markets; an edict permitted both.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Turks and Tuyuhun each requested border markets; an edict permitted both.

sentences.zh: 先是，中國喪亂，民乏耕牛，至是資於戎狄，雜畜被野。

translations.literal: Earlier, China had suffered disorder; the people lacked draft oxen; by this time they obtained them from the barbarians, and mixed livestock covered the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, China had suffered disorder and the people lacked draft oxen; by this time they obtained them from the barbarians, and mixed livestock covered the fields.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，乙亥，党項寇渭州。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yihai, the Tangut raided Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on yihai, the Tangut raided Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上幸鄠縣，校獵於甘谷，營太和宮於終南山；

translations.literal: On jiashen, the emperor visited Hu County, conducted a hunting review at Gangu, and built Taihe Palace on Zhongnan Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the emperor visited Hu County, conducted a hunting review at Gangu, and built Taihe Palace on Zhongnan Mountain;

sentences.zh: 丙戌，還宮。

translations.literal: on bingxu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: on bingxu, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 西突厥統葉護可汗遣使請婚，上謂裴矩曰：「西突厥道遠，緩急不能相助，今求婚，何如？」

translations.literal: The Western Turk khan Tongyehu sent envoys to request marriage; the emperor said to Pei Ju, "The Western Turks are far away and in urgency or ease cannot aid us—now they seek marriage; what do you think?"
translations.idiomatic: Western Turk Khan Tongyehu sent envoys to request marriage; the emperor said to Pei Ju, "The Western Turks are far away and cannot aid us in time of need—now they seek marriage; what do you think?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「今北寇方強，為國家今日計，且當遠交而近攻，臣謂宜許其婚以威頡利；

translations.literal: He replied, "Now the northern foe is still strong; for the state's plan today, we ought for the moment to befriend those far and attack those near; your servant thinks we should grant the marriage to overawe Jieli;
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Now the northern foe is still strong; for the state's plan today, we ought for the moment to befriend those far and attack those near; I think we should grant the marriage to overawe Jieli;

sentences.zh: 俟數年之後，中國完實，足抗北夷，然後徐思其宜。」

translations.literal: wait several years until China is complete and solid and sufficient to resist the northern barbarians, and then slowly consider what is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: wait several years until China is complete and solid and sufficient to resist the northern barbarians, and then slowly consider what is fitting."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this advice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed this advice.

sentences.zh: 遣高平王道立至其國，統葉護大喜。

translations.literal: He sent the Prince of Gaoping, Daoli, to their state; Tongyehu was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Prince of Gaoping Li Daoli to their state; Tongyehu was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 道立，上之從子也。

translations.literal: Daoli was the emperor's nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Daoli was the emperor's nephew.

sentences.zh: 初，上以天下大定，罷十二軍。

translations.literal: Earlier, because the realm was greatly settled, the emperor disbanded the twelve armies.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because the realm was greatly settled, the emperor had disbanded the twelve armies.

sentences.zh: 既而突厥為寇不已，辛亥，復置十二軍，以太常卿竇誕等為將軍，簡練士馬，議大舉擊突厥。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because the Turks raided without cease, on xinhai the twelve armies were re-established, with the Minister of Imperial Rites Dou Yan and others as generals; troops and horses were selected and trained, and a great campaign against the Turks was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because the Turks raided without cease, on xinhai the twelve armies were re-established, with Minister of Imperial Rites Dou Yan and others as generals; troops and horses were selected and trained, and a great campaign against the Turks was discussed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，涼州胡睦伽陀引突厥襲都督府，入子城；

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Liangzhou Hu Mujiatuo led the Turks in a surprise attack on the area headquarters and entered the inner city;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Liang Prefecture Hu Mujiatuo led the Turks in a surprise attack on the area headquarters and entered the inner city;

sentences.zh: 長史劉君傑擊破之。

translations.literal: the chief clerk Liu Junjie attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk Liu Junjie attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月，甲子，上幸太和宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi, the emperor visited Taihe Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiazi, the emperor visited Taihe Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣燕郡王李藝屯華亭縣及彈箏峽，水部郎中姜行本斷石嶺道以備突厥。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Prince of Yanjun Li Yi was sent to garrison Huating County and Tanzheng Gorge; the Water Bureau director Jiang Xingben blocked the Shiling road to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Prince of Yanjun Li Yi was sent to garrison Huating County and Tanzheng Gorge; Water Bureau Director Jiang Xingben blocked the Shiling road to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，頡利可汗寇靈州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Khan Jieli raided Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Khan Jieli raided Ling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以右衛大將軍張瑾為行軍總管以御之，以中書侍郎溫彥博為長史。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Right Weida general Zhang Jin was made campaign commander to resist him, with the Secretariat vice-director Wen Yanbo as chief clerk.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Right Weida General Zhang Jin was made campaign commander to resist him, with Secretariat Vice-Director Wen Yanbo as chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 先是，上與突厥書用敵國禮，秋，七月，甲辰，上謂侍臣曰：「突厥貪婪無厭，朕將征之，自今勿復為書，皆用詔敕。」

translations.literal: Earlier, in letters to the Turks the emperor had used the etiquette of equal states; in autumn, the seventh month, on jiachen, the emperor said to his attending ministers, "The Turks are greedy and insatiable; I shall campaign against them; from now on do not write letters again—use only edicts and commands."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in letters to the Turks the emperor had used the etiquette of equal states; in autumn, the seventh month, on jiachen, the emperor said to his attending ministers, "The Turks are greedy and insatiable; I shall campaign against them; from now on do not write letters again—use only edicts and commands."

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己酉，突厥頡利可汗寇相州。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Turk khan Jieli raided Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Turk Khan Jieli raided Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 睦伽陀攻武興。

translations.literal: Mujiatuo attacked Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Mujiatuo attacked Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，代州都督藺謨與突厥戰於新城，不利；

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Daizhou area commander Lin Mo fought the Turks at Xincheng with an unfavorable outcome;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Dai Prefecture area commander Lin Mo fought the Turks at Xincheng with an unfavorable outcome;

sentences.zh: 覆命行軍總管張瑾屯石嶺，李高遷趨大谷以御之。

translations.literal: orders were sent again for the campaign commander Zhang Jin to encamp at Shiling and Li Gaoqian to hurry to Dagu to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: orders were sent again for campaign commander Zhang Jin to encamp at Shiling and Li Gaoqian to hurry to Dagu to resist them.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命秦王出屯蒲州以備突厥。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Prince of Qin was ordered to go out and encamp at Puzhou to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Prince of Qin was ordered to go out and encamp at Pu Prefecture to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 八月，壬戌，突厥逾石嶺，寇并州；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renxu, the Turks crossed Shiling and raided Bingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renxu, the Turks crossed Shiling and raided Bing Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 癸亥，寇靈州；

translations.literal: on guihai, they raided Lingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: on guihai, they raided Ling Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 丁卯，寇潞、沁、韓三州。

translations.literal: on dingmao, they raided the three prefectures of Lu, Qin, and Han.
translations.idiomatic: on dingmao, they raided the three prefectures of Lu, Qin, and Han.

sentences.zh: 左武候大將軍安修仁擊睦伽陀於且渠川，破之。

translations.literal: The Left Wuhou grand general An Xiuren attacked Mujiatuo at the Quju River and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Left Wuhou Grand General An Xiuren attacked Mujiatuo at the Quju River and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 詔安州大都督李靖出潞州道，行軍總客任瑰屯太行，以御突厥。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Anzhou grand area commander Li Jing to advance by the Luzhou route and the campaign commander Ren Gui to encamp at Taihang to resist the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered An Prefecture grand area commander Li Jing to advance by the Lu Prefecture route and campaign commander Ren Gui to encamp at Taihang to resist the Turks.

sentences.zh: 頡利可汗將兵十餘萬大掠朔州。

translations.literal: Khan Jieli led more than a hundred thousand troops in a great plunder of Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Khan Jieli led more than a hundred thousand troops in a great plunder of Shuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，并州道行軍總管張瑾與突厥戰於太谷，全軍皆沒，瑾脫身奔李靖。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Bingzhou-route campaign commander Zhang Jin fought the Turks at Taigu; the whole army was destroyed; Jin escaped alone and fled to Li Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Bing Prefecture-route campaign commander Zhang Jin fought the Turks at Taigu; the whole army was destroyed; Jin escaped alone and fled to Li Jing.

sentences.zh: 行軍長史溫彥博為虜所執，虜以彥博職在機近，問以國家兵糧虛實，彥博不對，虜遷之陰山。

translations.literal: The campaign chief clerk Wen Yanbo was seized by the barbarians; because Yanbo's post was close to the inner councils, they questioned him on the state's military strength and grain stores, true and false; Yanbo did not answer, and the barbarians moved him to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign chief clerk Wen Yanbo was seized by the barbarians; because Yanbo's post was close to the inner councils, they questioned him on the state's military strength and grain stores; Yanbo did not answer, and the barbarians moved him to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，突厥寇靈武。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Turks raided Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Turks raided Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，靈州都督任城王道宗擊破之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Lingzhou area commander, Prince of Rencheng Daozong, attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Ling Prefecture area commander Prince of Rencheng Li Daozong attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，突厥寇綏州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Turks raided Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Turks raided Sui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，頡利可汗遣使請和而退。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Khan Jieli sent envoys to request peace and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Khan Jieli sent envoys to request peace and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月，癸巳，突厥沒賀咄設陷并州一縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guisi, the Turk Mohezhuoshe seized one county of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi, the Turk Mohezhuoshe seized one county of Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙申，代州都督藺謨擊破之。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Daizhou area commander Lin Mo attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Dai Prefecture area commander Lin Mo attacked and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，初令太府檢校諸州權量。

translations.literal: On guimao, for the first time the Grand Treasury was ordered to inspect and verify the standard weights of all prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, for the first time the Grand Treasury was ordered to inspect and verify the standard weights of all prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丙午，右領軍將軍王君廓破突厥於幽州，俘斬二千餘人。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Right Lingjun general Wang Junkuo defeated the Turks at Youzhou, capturing and killing more than two thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Right Lingjun General Wang Junkuo defeated the Turks at You Prefecture, capturing and killing more than two thousand men.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇藺州。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Linzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided Lin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，壬申，吐谷渾寇疊州，遣扶州刺史蔣善合救之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renshen, Tuyuhun raided Diezhou; the Fu Prefecture prefect Jiang Shanhe was sent to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on renshen, Tuyuhun raided Die Prefecture; Fu Prefecture prefect Jiang Shanhe was sent to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，突厥寇鄯州，遣霍公柴紹救之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Turks raided Shanzhou; Duke of Huo Chai Shao was sent to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Turks raided Shan Prefecture; Duke of Huo Chai Shao was sent to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 十一月，辛卯朔，上幸宜州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, the first day of the month, the emperor visited Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the first day xinmao, the emperor went to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 權檢校侍中裴矩罷判黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: Acting Palace Attendant-in-Chief Pei Ju was relieved of his concurrent duty as Vice Minister of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Palace Attendant-in-Chief Pei Ju was relieved of his concurrent post as Vice Minister of the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，突厥寇彭州。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Turks raided Pengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Turks raided Peng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以天策司馬宇文士及權檢校侍中。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Heavenly Stratagem Army marshal Yuwen Shiji was made acting Palace Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Heavenly Stratagem Army Marshal Yuwen Shiji was appointed acting Palace Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，徙蜀王元軌為吳王，漢王元慶為陳王。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Prince of Shu Yuan Gui was moved to Prince of Wu; Prince of Han Yuan Qing was moved to Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Prince of Shu Li Yuan Gui was redesignated Prince of Wu, and Prince of Han Li Yuan Qing was redesignated Prince of Chen.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，加秦王世民中書令，齊王元吉侍中。

translations.literal: On guimao, Prince of Qin Shimin was additionally made Palace Director; Prince of Qi Yuanji was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Prince of Qin Li Shimin was additionally appointed Palace Director, and Prince of Qi Li Yuanji was made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 丙午，吐谷渾寇岷州。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Tuyuhun raided Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Tuyuhun raided Min Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，眉州山獠反。

translations.literal: On wushen, the mountain Liao of Meizhou rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the mountain Liao of Mei Prefecture rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 十二月，辛酉，上還至京師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, the emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上校獵於鳴犢泉；

translations.literal: On gengchen, the emperor conducted a hunting review at Mingdu Spring;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the emperor reviewed the hunt at Mingdu Spring;

sentences.zh: 辛巳，還宮。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 以襄邑王神符檢校揚州大都督。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiangyi Shenfu was made inspector-in-chief of the Yangzhou superior area command.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangyi Li Shenfu was appointed inspector-in-chief of the Yangzhou superior area command.

sentences.zh: 始自丹楊徙州府及居民於江北。

translations.literal: For the first time the prefectural seat and the residents were moved from Danyang to north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time the prefectural seat and its residents were moved from Danyang north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，己亥，詔太常少卿祖孝孫等更定雅樂。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jihai, an edict ordered Grand Music Master Vice Director Zu Xiaosun and others to revise the court music.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on jihai, an edict ordered Grand Music Master Vice Director Zu Xiaosun and others to revise the court music.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以左僕射裴寂為司空，日遣員外郎一個更直其第。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Left Vice Minister of Works Pei Ji was made Minister of Works; each day one exterior department official was sent on rotating duty at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Left Vice Minister of Works Pei Ji was appointed Minister of Works; each day one exterior department official was assigned on rotating duty at his residence.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚申，以齊王元吉為司徒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengshen, Prince of Qi Yuanji was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, Prince of Qi Li Yuanji was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 丙子，初令州縣祀社稷，又令士民裡閉相從立社。

translations.literal: On bingzi, for the first time prefectures and counties were ordered to sacrifice to the altars of soil and grain; gentry and commoners were also ordered in lane associations to join in establishing altars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, prefectures and counties were for the first time ordered to sacrifice to the altars of soil and grain, and gentry and commoners were also to form lane associations and establish altars together.

sentences.zh: 各申祈報，用洽鄉黨之歡。

translations.literal: Each was to offer prayers of thanks and report, to bring harmony to village and neighborhood joy.
translations.idiomatic: Each group was to offer prayers of thanksgiving and report, fostering goodwill among neighbors.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上祀社稷。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the emperor sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the emperor sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，突厥寇原州，遣折威將軍楊毛擊之。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Turks raided Yuanzhou; the court sent General Who Suppresses Might Yang Mao to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Turks raided Yuan Prefecture; the court sent General Who Suppresses Might Yang Mao to attack them.

sentences.zh: 三月，庚寅，上幸昆明池；

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, the emperor visited Kunming Pond;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, the emperor visited Kunming Pond;

sentences.zh: 壬辰，還宮。

translations.literal: On renchen, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，吐谷渾、党項寇岷州。

translations.literal: On guisi, Tuyuhun and the Qiang tribes raided Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Tuyuhun and the Qiang tribes raided Min Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，益州道行台尚書郭行方擊眉州叛獠，破之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Guo Xingfang, acting area commander-in-chief of the Yizhou route, attacked the rebel Liao of Meizhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yizhou-route acting area commander-in-chief Guo Xingfang attacked the rebel Liao of Mei Prefecture and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，梁師都寇邊，陷靜難鎮。

translations.literal: On renyin, Liang Shidu raided the frontier and seized Jingnan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Liang Shidu raided the frontier and seized Jingnan garrison.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上幸周氏陂。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the emperor visited the Zhou clan embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the emperor visited the Zhou clan embankment.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，突厥寇靈州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Turks raided Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Turks raided Ling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yimao, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，南海公歐陽胤奉使在突厥，帥其徒五十人謀掩襲可汗牙帳；

translations.literal: On guichou, Ouyang Yin, Duke of Nanhai, on mission among the Turks, led his party of fifty men in a plot to surprise the khan's camp by night;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Duke of Nanhai Ouyang Yin, while on mission among the Turks, led his party of fifty men in a plot to surprise the khan's camp by night;

sentences.zh: 事洩，突厥囚之。

translations.literal: The affair leaked out, and the Turks imprisoned them.
translations.idiomatic: The plot was discovered, and the Turks imprisoned them.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，突厥寇涼州，都督長樂王幼良擊走之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Turks raided Liangzhou; area commander Prince of Changle Youliang attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Turks raided Liang Prefecture; area commander Prince of Changle Li Youliang attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 戊午，郭行方擊叛獠於洪、雅二州，大破之，俘男女五千口。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Guo Xingfang attacked the rebel Liao in Hong and Ya prefectures and inflicted a great defeat, capturing men and women numbering five thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Guo Xingfang attacked the rebel Liao in Hong and Ya prefectures and won a great victory, capturing five thousand men and women.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁卯，突厥寇朔州；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingmao, the Turks raided Shuozhou;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on dingmao, the Turks raided Shuo Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 庚午，寇原州；

translations.literal: On gengwu, they raided Yuanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, they raided Yuan Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 癸酉，寇涇州。

translations.literal: On guiyou, they raided Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, they raided Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，安州大都督李靖與突厥頡利可汗戰於靈州之硤石，自旦至申，突厥乃退。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Anzhou superior area commander Li Jing fought Khan Jieli of the Turks at Xiashi in Lingzhou; from dawn until shen the Turks withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, An Prefecture superior area commander Li Jing fought Khan Jieli of the Turks at Xiashi in Ling Prefecture; from dawn until the hour shen the Turks withdrew.

sentences.zh: 太史令傅奕上疏請除佛法曰：「佛在西域，言妖路遠；

translations.literal: Grand Astrologer Fu Yi submitted a memorial requesting abolition of the Buddhist Law, saying: "The Buddha is in the Western Regions—his speech is demonic, his road far;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Astrologer Fu Yi submitted a memorial requesting the abolition of Buddhism, saying, "Buddha arose in the Western Regions, his teachings demonic and his path remote;

sentences.zh: 漢譯胡書，恣其假托。

translations.literal: The Han translated barbarian books and indulged their fabricated pretensions.
translations.idiomatic: When Chinese translated those foreign scriptures, they let impostors invent whatever they pleased.

sentences.zh: 使不忠不孝削髮而揖君親，游手游食易服以逃租賦。

translations.literal: They made the disloyal and unfilial shave their heads yet bow to ruler and kin, idlers who ate without labor, changing dress to escape taxes and levies.
translations.idiomatic: They turned the disloyal and unfilial into shaven monks who still made obeisance to rulers and kin, idle wanderers who ate without working, changing their dress to evade taxes and levies.

sentences.zh: 偽啟三塗，謬張六道，恐心曷愚夫，詐欺庸品。

translations.literal: Falsely they opened the three paths, absurdly they spread the six paths, terrifying hearts and deceiving foolish men, swindling the vulgar masses.
translations.idiomatic: They falsely proclaimed the three evil paths and absurdly expounded the six rebirths, terrifying hearts and fooling simple men, defrauding the common crowd.

sentences.zh: 乃追懺既往之罪，虛規將來之福；

translations.literal: Then they pursued repentance for past sins and vainly plotted future blessings;
translations.idiomatic: They urged repentance for sins already committed and vainly promised blessings yet to come;

sentences.zh: 佈施萬錢，希萬倍之報，持齋一日，冀百日之糧。

translations.literal: Scattering ten thousand cash, they hoped for ten thousandfold return; keeping fast one day, they expected a hundred days' grain.
translations.idiomatic: Give ten thousand coins in alms and hope for ten thousandfold reward; fast one day and expect grain enough for a hundred.

sentences.zh: 遂使愚迷，妄求功德，不憚科禁，輕犯憲章；

translations.literal: Thus they made the foolish deluded, recklessly seeking merit, not fearing statutes, lightly violating the code;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the foolish were led astray to seek merit recklessly, unafraid of the law, lightly breaking the statutes;

sentences.zh: 有造為惡逆，身墜刑網，方乃獄中禮佛，規免其罪。

translations.literal: Some who committed wicked treason and fell into the penal net only then worshipped the Buddha in prison, plotting to escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Men who had committed treason and fallen into the executioner's net would worship Buddha in prison, hoping thereby to escape punishment.

sentences.zh: 且生死壽夭，由於自然；

translations.literal: Moreover life, death, longevity, and early death depend on nature;
translations.idiomatic: Life, death, length of days, and early demise all follow nature;

sentences.zh: 刑德威福，關之人主；

translations.literal: Punishment, virtue, authority, and blessing concern the human ruler;
translations.idiomatic: Punishment, favor, authority, and blessing depend on the sovereign;

sentences.zh: 貧富貴賤，功業所招；

translations.literal: Poverty, wealth, noble and base are summoned by achievement;
translations.idiomatic: Poverty, wealth, noble rank and low come from one's deeds;

sentences.zh: 而愚僧矯詐，皆雲由佛。

translations.literal: Yet foolish monks deceitfully claim all come from the Buddha.
translations.idiomatic: Yet deluded monks lie and claim all this comes from Buddha.

sentences.zh: 竊人主之權，擅造化之力，其為害政，良可悲矣！

translations.literal: They usurp the human ruler's authority and monopolize creation's power—how their harm to government is truly lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: They usurp the sovereign's power and arrogate to themselves the force of creation—how harmful this is to government is truly lamentable!

sentences.zh: 降自羲、農，至於有漢，皆無佛法，君明臣忠，祚長年久。

translations.literal: From Fuxi and Shennong down to the Han, all had no Buddhist law; rulers were enlightened, ministers loyal, reigns long and years many.
translations.idiomatic: From the age of Fuxi and Shennong down through the Han there was no Buddhism; rulers were wise, ministers loyal, and dynasties endured.

sentences.zh: 漢明帝始立胡神，西域桑門自傳其法。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Han first established the barbarian god; Western Region shramanas transmitted their law themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of Han first set up this foreign god, and shramanas from the Western Regions spread their teaching of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 西晉以上，國有嚴科，不許中國之人輒行髡發之事。

translations.literal: In Western Jin and above, the state had stern statutes, not permitting people of China rashly to perform shaving of the head.
translations.idiomatic: Through Western Jin and earlier dynasties the state kept strict laws forbidding Chinese subjects to shave their heads.

sentences.zh: 洎於苻、石，羌、胡亂華，主庸臣佞，政虐祚短，梁武、齊襄，足為明鏡。

translations.literal: When it reached Fu and Shi, Qiang and Hu disturbed China, rulers were mediocre and ministers flatterers, government cruel and reigns short—Emperor Wu of Liang and Wenxiang of Qi suffice as bright mirrors.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Fu and Shi regimes, Qiang and Hu ravaged China; rulers grew feeble and ministers sycophantic, rule turned harsh and reigns brief—Emperor Wu of Liang and Wenxiang of Qi stand as clear mirrors.

sentences.zh: 今天下僧尼，數盈十萬，剪刻繒彩，裝束泥人，競為厭魅，迷惑萬姓。

translations.literal: Today monks and nuns under Heaven number more than a hundred thousand, cutting and carving silk, dressing clay figures, competing in sorcery, bewildering the myriad clans.
translations.idiomatic: Today monks and nuns number more than a hundred thousand; they cut silk into ornaments, dress clay images, and vie in black magic that misleads the people.

sentences.zh: 請令匹配，即成十成餘戶，產育男女，十年長養，一紀教訓，可以足兵。

translations.literal: I ask that they be ordered to marry—then they will complete more than ten parts in households; bearing sons and daughters, ten years' nurture, one cycle's teaching, they can fill the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Order them matched in marriage and they will form more than ten-part households; after bearing children, ten years of rearing and twelve years of training would supply troops enough.

sentences.zh: 四海免蠶食之殃，百姓知威福所在，則妖惑之風自革，淳樸之化還興。

translations.literal: Within the Four Seas they would be spared the calamity of silkworms' devouring; the hundred surnames would know where authority and blessing lie—then the wind of demonic delusion would reform itself and plain honesty's transformation return and rise.
translations.idiomatic: The realm would be spared the devouring of silkworms; the people would know where reward and punishment lie; the wind of demonic deception would die away and honest custom revive.

sentences.zh: 竊見齊朝章仇子佗表言：『僧尼徒眾，糜損國家，寺塔奢侈，虛費金帛。』

translations.literal: I have seen in stealth the Qi dynasty Zhangqiu Zituo's memorial saying: 'The monk and nun congregations waste and damage the state; temples and pagodas are extravagant, vainly spending gold and silk.'
translations.idiomatic: I recall Zhangqiu Zituo of the Qi dynasty, who wrote: 'The monk and nun orders drain the state; temples and pagodas are luxurious and waste gold and silk.'

sentences.zh: 為諸僧附會宰相，對朝讒毀，諸尼依托妃、主，潛行謗讟，子佗竟被囚執，刑於都市。

translations.literal: Various monks attached themselves to the chief minister and slandered him at court; various nuns relied on consorts and princesses and secretly carried out vilification—Zituo in the end was seized and imprisoned, executed in the market city.
translations.idiomatic: Monks colluded with the chief minister to slander him at court; nuns relied on consorts and princesses to spread secret calumny. Zituo was seized in the end and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 及周武平齊，制封其墓。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Zhou pacified Qi, he ordered his tomb enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Zhou conquered Qi, he had Zituo's tomb enfeoffed in honor.

sentences.zh: 臣雖不敏，竊慕其蹤。」

translations.literal: Though your servant is not clever, in stealth I admire his traces."
translations.idiomatic: Though I am unworthy, I secretly admire his example."
