translations.literal: When Zheng reached Cizhou, he met prefectures and counties escorting in bonds the former crown prince's thousand-bolt Li Zhian and the Prince of Qi's guard commander Li Shihang bound for the capital; Zheng said: "From the day I received my commission, the former palace's and Prince of Qi's household retainers were all pardoned and not questioned;
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng reached Ci Prefecture, he met prefectural officers escorting in bonds the former crown prince's thousand-bolt Li Zhian and the Prince of Qi's guard commander Li Shihang bound for the capital. Zheng said, "From the day I received my commission, those of the former palace and the Prince of Qi's household were all pardoned and not to be questioned;

sentences.zh: 今復送師行等，則誰不自疑！

translations.literal: if now again you send Shihang and the rest, then who would not suspect himself!
translations.idiomatic: if you now again send Shihang and the rest, who will not suspect himself!

sentences.zh: 雖遣使者，人誰信之！

translations.literal: though envoys are sent, who among the people would believe them!
translations.idiomatic: Though the court sends envoys, who would believe them!

sentences.zh: 吾不可以顧身嫌，不為國慮。

translations.literal: I cannot for personal misgiving fail to consider the state.
translations.idiomatic: I cannot for personal misgiving fail to consider the state.

sentences.zh: 且既蒙國士之遇，敢不以國士報之乎！」

translations.literal: Moreover, since I have received the state's fellowship, how dare I not repay it as a man of the state would!"
translations.idiomatic: And since I have received the state's fellowship, how dare I not repay it as a man of the state would!"

sentences.zh: 遂皆解縱之。

translations.literal: He thereupon all released and set them free.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon released them all.

sentences.zh: 太子聞之，甚喜。

translations.literal: When the crown prince heard of it, he was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince heard of it, he was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 右衛率府鎧曹參軍唐臨出為萬泉丞，縣有系囚十許人，會春雨，臨縱之，使歸耕種，皆如期而返。

translations.literal: Right Guard rate office armor-camp registrar Tang Lin went out as Wanquan assistant magistrate; the county had prisoners held, some ten or so; when spring rains came, Lin released them and had them return to plow and plant; all returned on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard Rate Office armor-camp registrar Tang Lin went out as Wanquan assistant magistrate; the county held some ten or so prisoners; when spring rains came, Lin released them to return home and plow and plant, and all came back on schedule.

sentences.zh: 臨，令則之弟子也。

translations.literal: Lin was Lingze's nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Lin was Study Horse Lingze's nephew.

sentences.zh: 八月，丙辰，突厥遣使請和。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingchen, the Turks sent envoys requesting peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingchen, the Turks sent envoys requesting peace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，吐谷渾遣使請和。

translations.literal: On renxu, Tuyuhun sent envoys requesting peace.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Tuyuhun sent envoys requesting peace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔傳位於太子。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict ordered the transfer of the throne to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, an edict ordered the transfer of the throne to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太子固辭，不許。

translations.literal: The crown prince firmly declined; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince firmly declined and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太宗即皇帝位於東宮顯德殿，赦天下；

translations.literal: On jiazi, Taizong took the emperor's position at the Eastern Palace's Xiande Hall, amnestied all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Emperor Taizong took the throne at the Eastern Palace's Xiande Hall and amnestied the realm;

sentences.zh: 關內及蒲、芮、虞、泰、陝、鼎六州免租調二年，自餘給復一年。

translations.literal: Within the passes and the six prefectures Pu, Rui, Yu, Tai, Shan, and Ding were exempted from tax and corvée for two years; elsewhere relief was granted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Within the passes and the six prefectures Pu, Rui, Yu, Tai, Shan, and Ding were exempted from tax and corvée for two years; elsewhere relief was granted for one year.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔以「宮女眾多，幽閟可愍，宜簡出之，各歸親戚，任其適人。」

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict said, "The palace women are many; their seclusion is pitiable; they should be selected out, each returned to kinfolk, allowing them to marry as they will."
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict said, "The palace women are many; their seclusion is pitiable; they should be selected out and each returned to her kinfolk to marry as she wills."

sentences.zh: 初，稽胡酋長劉屳成帥眾降梁師都，師都信讒殺之，由是所部猜懼，多來降者。

translations.literal: Earlier, Ji-hu chieftain Liu Shancheng led his masses to submit to Liang Shidu; Shidu believed slander and killed him; thereby his subordinates were suspicious and fearful, and many came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Ji-hu chieftain Liu Shancheng had led his followers to submit to Liang Shidu; Shidu believed slander and killed him, whereupon his followers grew suspicious and fearful, and many came over to Tang.

sentences.zh: 師都浸衰弱，乃朝於突厥，為之畫策，勸令入寇。

translations.literal: Shidu gradually weakened; he then attended court at the Turks and for them drew up plans, urging them to enter and raid.
translations.idiomatic: As Shidu grew weaker, he went to pay court to the Turks and plotted for them, urging them to invade.

sentences.zh: 於是頡利、突利二可汗合兵十餘萬騎寇涇州，進至武功，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Thereupon the two khans Jieli and Tuli combined armies of more than a hundred thousand horsemen and raided Jing Prefecture, advancing to Wugong; the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the two khans Jieli and Tuli combined more than a hundred thousand horsemen and raided Jing Prefecture, advancing as far as Wugong; the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立妃長孫氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the consort of the clan Zhangsun was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Consort Zhangsun was made empress.

sentences.zh: 后少好讀書，造次必循禮法。

translations.literal: The empress from youth loved reading; in every hasty moment she necessarily followed ritual and law.
translations.idiomatic: The empress had loved reading from youth and in every situation observed ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 上為秦王，與太子建成、齊王元吉有隙，后奉事高祖，承順妃嬪，彌縫其闕，甚有內助。

translations.literal: When the emperor was Prince of Qin, he had a rift with crown prince Jiancheng and Prince of Qi Yuanji; the empress served Gaozu, complied with the consorts, mended their gaps, and had great inner assistance.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was Prince of Qin he was at odds with Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince of Qi Yuanji; the empress attended Gaozu, won over the consorts, and smoothed over their faults, giving great help within the palace.

sentences.zh: 及正位中宮，務崇節儉，服御取給而已。

translations.literal: When she took the correct position in the central palace, she devoted herself to promoting thrift; dress and use were taken only as sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Once she held the central palace, she devoted herself to thrift; her dress and furnishings were only what sufficed.

sentences.zh: 上深重之，嘗與之議賞罰，后辭曰：「『牝雞之晨，唯家之索』，妾婦人，安敢豫聞政事！」

translations.literal: The emperor deeply valued her; once he deliberated rewards and punishments with her; the empress declined, saying, "'When the hen crows at dawn, the house is undone'—I am a wife and woman; how dare I presume to hear of government affairs!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor valued her deeply and once discussed rewards and punishments with her; the empress declined, saying, "'When the hen crows at dawn, the house is undone'—I am only a woman; how dare I presume to hear of government affairs!"

sentences.zh: 固問之，終不對。

translations.literal: He firmly questioned her; in the end she did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed her repeatedly, but she would not answer.

sentences.zh: 己卯，突厥進寇高陵。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Turks advanced and raided Gaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Turks advanced and raided Gaoling.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，涇州道行軍總管尉遲敬德與突厥戰於涇陽，大破之，獲其俟斤阿史德烏沒啜，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Jingzhou circuit campaigning grand general Yuchi Jingde fought the Turks at Jingyang, greatly defeated them, captured their irkin Ashina Shide Wumochuo, and beheaded more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jingzhou circuit campaigning commander Yuchi Jingde fought the Turks at Jingyang and routed them, capturing their irkin Ashina Shide Wumochuo and taking more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 癸未，頡利可汗進至渭水便橋之北，遣其腹心執失思力入見，以觀虛實。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Jieli Khan advanced to north of the Wei River's Bian Bridge, sent his trusted man Zhishi Sili to enter and see, to observe emptiness and substance.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Jieli Khan advanced to the north bank of the Wei River at Bian Bridge and sent his trusted man Zhishi Sili to audience to probe the court's strength.

sentences.zh: 思力盛稱「頡利、突利二可汗將兵百萬，今至矣。」

translations.literal: Sili greatly proclaimed, "The two khans Jieli and Tuli will lead a million troops; they have now arrived."
translations.idiomatic: Sili boasted loudly, "The two khans Jieli and Tuli are leading a million men—they have arrived now."

sentences.zh: 上讓之曰：「吾與汝可汗面結和親，贈遺金帛，前後無算。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached him, saying, "I with your khan face to face bound marriage alliance, bestowed gold and silks, before and after without reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reproached him, saying, "I bound myself in marriage alliance with your khan face to face and bestowed gold and silks beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 汝可汗自負盟約，引兵深入，於我無愧？

translations.literal: Your khan himself relied on the alliance pact, led troops deep in—toward me is there no shame?
translations.idiomatic: Your khan broke the alliance and led his army deep into our land—do you feel no shame toward us?

sentences.zh: 汝雖戎狄，亦有人心，何得全忘大恩，自誇強盛？

translations.literal: Though you are Rong and Di, you also have human hearts—how can you wholly forget great grace and boast of strength and flourishing?
translations.idiomatic: Though you are barbarians, you still have human hearts—how can you utterly forget great kindness and boast of your strength?

sentences.zh: 我今先斬汝矣！」

translations.literal: I now will first behead you!"
translations.idiomatic: I will behead you first!"

sentences.zh: 思力懼而請命。

translations.literal: Sili feared and begged for his life.
translations.idiomatic: Sili was afraid and begged for his life.

sentences.zh: 蕭瑀、封德彝請禮遣之。

translations.literal: Xiao Yu and Feng Deyi requested ceremonially to send him away.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu and Feng Deyi asked that he be sent away with ceremony.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「我今遣還，虜謂我畏之，愈肆憑陵。」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "If I now send him back, the barbarians will say I fear them and will increasingly indulge in encroachment."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "If I send him back now, the barbarians will think I fear them and encroach all the more."

sentences.zh: 乃囚思力於門下省。

translations.literal: He then imprisoned Sili in the Gate Down Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He then imprisoned Sili in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上自出玄武門，與高士廉、房玄齡等立騎逕詣渭水上，與頡利隔水而語，責以負約。

translations.literal: The emperor himself went out from Xuanwu Gate; with Gao Shilian, Fang Xuanling, and others he stood on horseback and went straight to the Wei River's waters; with Jieli separated by water he spoke, reproaching him for breaking the pact.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor himself rode out through Xuanwu Gate; with Gao Shilian, Fang Xuanling, and others he went straight to the Wei River on horseback and spoke with Jieli across the water, reproaching him for breaking the pact.

sentences.zh: 突厥大驚，皆下馬羅拜。

translations.literal: The Turks were greatly alarmed; all dismounted and bowed in array.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks were greatly alarmed; all dismounted and bowed in array.

sentences.zh: 俄而諸軍繼至，旌甲蔽野，頡利見執失思力不返，而上挺身輕出，軍容甚盛，有懼色。

translations.literal: Before long the various armies followed and arrived; banners and armor covered the wilds; Jieli saw Zhishi Sili not return, while the emperor stood forth lightly going out; military appearance was very grand; he had a look of fear.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the armies arrived in succession, banners and armor covering the plain; Jieli saw that Zhishi Sili had not returned, while the emperor had come forth lightly with so splendid an army, and he showed fear.

sentences.zh: 上麾諸軍使卻而布陳，獨留與頡利語。

translations.literal: The emperor waved the armies to make them withdraw and deploy formations; alone he remained to speak with Jieli.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor waved the armies back to form battle lines and stayed alone to speak with Jieli.

sentences.zh: 蕭瑀以上輕敵，叩馬固諫，上曰：「吾籌之已熟，非卿所知。

translations.literal: Xiao Yu because the emperor slighted the enemy, knocked the horse and firmly remonstrated; the emperor said, "I have planned this to ripeness; it is not what you know.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu thought the emperor was slighting the enemy and seized his horse to remonstrate firmly; the emperor said, "I have thought this through; it is not for you to know.

sentences.zh: 突厥所以敢傾國而來，直抵郊甸者，以我國內有難，朕新即位，謂我不能抗禦故也。

translations.literal: The reason the Turks dared to empty the state and come, reaching straight to the suburban fields, is that within our state there was difficulty, I newly took the throne, and they thought I could not resist and defend.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks dared bring their whole nation to the capital suburbs because they thought that with trouble within our state and my new accession I could not resist them.

sentences.zh: 我若示之心弱，閉門拒守，虜必放兵大掠，不可復制。

translations.literal: If I showed a weak heart, closed the gates and refused to defend, the barbarians would necessarily unleash troops in great plundering and could not again be controlled.
translations.idiomatic: If I showed weakness, shut the gates, and held to defense, the barbarians would surely let their troops loose in great pillage beyond control.

sentences.zh: 故朕輕騎獨出，示若輕之；

translations.literal: Therefore I lightly rode out alone, showing as if slighting them;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I came out lightly alone, as if slighting them;

sentences.zh: 又震曜軍容，使之必戰；

translations.literal: again shook and displayed military appearance, making them necessarily fight;
translations.idiomatic: and again displayed our army's might to make them think battle certain;

sentences.zh: 出虜不意，使之失圖。

translations.literal: going beyond the barbarians' expectation, making them lose their plans.
translations.idiomatic: catching the barbarians off guard and unsettling their plans.

sentences.zh: 虜入我地既深，必有懼心，故與戰則克，與和則固矣。

translations.literal: The barbarians having entered our land already deep, necessarily have a fearful heart; therefore if we fight we conquer, if we make peace we are secure.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarians have penetrated deep into our land and must be afraid; therefore if we fight we win, and if we make peace we are secure.

sentences.zh: 制服突厥，在此一舉，卿第觀之！」

translations.literal: Subduing the Turks lies in this one move—you only observe it!"
translations.idiomatic: Subduing the Turks depends on this one move—just watch!"

sentences.zh: 是日，頡利來請和，詔許之。

translations.literal: That day Jieli came requesting peace; an edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: That day Jieli came requesting peace, and an edict granted it.

sentences.zh: 上即日還宮。

translations.literal: The emperor that same day returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，又幸城西，斬白馬，與頡利盟於便橋之上。

translations.literal: On yiyou, he again visited the west of the city, beheaded a white horse, and with Jieli made alliance atop Bian Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he again went to the west of the city, sacrificed a white horse, and made alliance with Jieli atop Bian Bridge.

sentences.zh: 突厥引兵退。

translations.literal: The Turks led troops and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks withdrew their army.

sentences.zh: 蕭瑀請於上曰：「突厥未和之時，諸將爭戰，陛下不許，臣等亦以為疑，既而虜自退，其策安在？」

translations.literal: Xiao Yu requested of the emperor, saying, "When the Turks were not yet at peace, the generals vied to fight; Your Majesty did not permit it; we ministers also thought it doubtful; afterward the barbarians themselves withdrew—where was the strategy?"
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu asked the emperor, "Before peace with the Turks, the generals were eager to fight, but Your Majesty would not allow it; we too were doubtful, yet afterward the barbarians withdrew of themselves—where lay the strategy?"

sentences.zh: 上曰：「吾觀突厥之眾雖多而不整，君臣之志惟賄是求，當其請和之時，可汗獨在水西，達官皆來謁我，我若醉而縛之，因襲擊其眾，勢如拉朽。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "I observe the Turks' masses, though many, are not orderly; ruler and ministers' intent seeks only bribes; when they requested peace, the khan alone was west of the water; high officials all came to attend on me; if I were drunk and bound them, then struck their masses, the momentum would be like pulling rotten wood.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I saw that though the Turk host was large it was not disciplined; ruler and ministers cared only for bribes. When they asked for peace, the khan alone was west of the river while his high officials all came to attend me; if I had seized them drunk and then struck their host, it would have been like pulling down rotten timber.

sentences.zh: 又命長孫無忌、李靖伏兵於豳州以待之，虜若奔歸，仗兵邀其前，大軍躡其後，覆之如反掌耳。

translations.literal: Again I ordered Zhangsun Wuji and Li Jing to lie in ambush at Bin Prefecture to await them; if the barbarians fled home, troops would bar their front and the great army tread on their rear—overturning them like turning the palm.
translations.idiomatic: I had also ordered Zhangsun Wuji and Li Jing to lie in ambush at Bin Prefecture; if the barbarians fled home, troops would block their front and the main army follow their rear—overthrowing them would have been as easy as turning the hand.

sentences.zh: 所以不戰者，吾即位日淺，國家未安，百姓未富，且當靜以撫之。

translations.literal: The reason for not fighting is that my accession days are shallow, the state is not yet secure, the hundred surnames are not yet rich; for the time being we should be quiet to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: The reason I did not fight is that I had just taken the throne, the state was not yet secure, and the people were not yet prosperous; for the time being we must calm and comfort them.

sentences.zh: 一與虜戰，所損甚多；

translations.literal: Once we fight the barbarians, the losses are very many;
translations.idiomatic: One battle with the barbarians would cost us heavily;

sentences.zh: 虜結怨既深，懼而修備，則吾未可以得志矣。

translations.literal: the barbarians' knot of resentment already deep, fearing and repairing defenses—then we could not yet realize our intent.
translations.idiomatic: the barbarians would bear a deep grudge, and in fear would strengthen their defenses, and we could not yet achieve our aim.

sentences.zh: 故卷甲韜戈，啖以金帛，彼既得所欲，理當自退，志意驕惰，不復設備，然後養威伺釁，一舉可滅也。

translations.literal: Therefore we rolled armor and sheathed weapons, fed them with gold and silks; they having obtained what they desired, by reason ought themselves to withdraw; ambition and will proud and slack, no longer setting defenses—then afterward we nurture might and watch for openings, and in one move can destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we rolled up armor and sheathed weapons and fed them gold and silks; once they had what they wanted, they would naturally withdraw, proud and slack and no longer on guard; then we could nurture our strength, watch for an opening, and destroy them in one stroke.

sentences.zh: 將欲取之，必固與之，此之謂矣。

translations.literal: To take, one must first give firm—this is what is meant.
translations.idiomatic: To take, one must first give firmly—such is the meaning.

sentences.zh: 卿知之乎？」

translations.literal: Do you understand it?"
translations.idiomatic: Do you understand?"

sentences.zh: 瑀再拜曰：「非所及也。」

translations.literal: Yu bowed twice and said, "Not what I could reach."
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu bowed twice and said, "That is beyond me."
